name: Sermons on Ecclesiastical Subjects, I
author: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning
desc: Sermons on Ecclesiastical Subjects, volume I (1863): the introduction on the relations of England to Christianity and thirteen sermons preached at the Provincial Councils of Westminster, in Rome, Paris and London, on dogmatic authority, the Council of Trent, divine faith, the Good Shepherd, unity and the Resurrection of the dry bones.
desc_pt: Sermões sobre Assuntos Eclesiásticos, volume I (1863): a introdução sobre as relações da Inglaterra com o cristianismo e treze sermões pregados nos Concílios Provinciais de Westminster, em Roma, Paris e Londres, sobre a autoridade dogmática, o Concílio de Trento, a fé divina, o Bom Pastor, a unidade e a ressurreição dos ossos secos.
editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns and Lambert, 1863)
edition: Sermons on Ecclesiastical Subjects (vol. 1) (London: Burns and Lambert, 1863), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The sermons and the introduction; the contents, the errata and the index are dropped.
